title: Town Hall starting points
description: Compatibility-first run settings for each current Home Village Town Hall. Choosing one only previews it; Apply preset loads it into the visible plan, and Apply plan is still required before anything is written.

presets.label: Town Hall 2
presets.summary: Short Standard-deployment check using the active profile army.
presets.description: No bundled CSV declares a Town Hall 2 training column, so this keeps the exact army already configured in the profile and uses the wired Standard deployment path.
presets.source_note: RunExecutionContract accepts legacy.standard; no shipped CSV TRAIN table covers TH2.

presets.label: Town Hall 3
presets.summary: Short Standard-deployment check using the active profile army.
presets.description: No bundled CSV declares a Town Hall 3 training column, so this keeps the exact army already configured in the profile and avoids assuming a deployment script fits it.
presets.source_note: RunExecutionContract accepts legacy.standard; no shipped CSV TRAIN table covers TH3.

presets.label: Town Hall 4
presets.summary: Standard deployment that preserves the visible Hero selection.
presets.description: No bundled CSV declares Town Hall 4 support. This uses the active profile army and Standard deployment, but it does not guess which Hero slots are active; the visible Hero selection stays unchanged and remains subject to Start validation.
presets.source_note: heroes.json unlocks Barbarian King at TH4; no shipped CSV TRAIN table covers TH4.

presets.label: Town Hall 5
presets.summary: Standard deployment preserving the profile army and visible Heroes.
presets.description: No bundled CSV declares Town Hall 5 support. This uses Standard deployment, waits for the profile army and its configured spells, preserves the visible Hero selection, and keeps the run deliberately short.
presets.source_note: RunExecutionContract accepts legacy.standard; no shipped CSV TRAIN table covers TH5.

presets.label: Town Hall 6
presets.summary: Barch deployment for a short run; the profile army must match.
presets.description: The bundled Barch file explicitly references TH06. This preset selects only its deployment routine; it does not import the file's training table or change the active profile army. King is selected because the current catalog unlocks him by TH6 and the CSV has a King DROP action.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/Barch four fingers.csv explicitly references TH06 and deploys King; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 7
presets.summary: GiWiHe deployment for TH7; the profile army must match.
presets.description: The bundled GiWiHe file explicitly references TH7. This preset selects only its deployment routine; it does not import troop or spell counts. King is selected from the intersection of current TH7 unlocks and the CSV's Hero DROP actions.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH7-12] GiWiHe v6.4.csv explicitly references TH7 and deploys King; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 8
presets.summary: GiWiHe deployment for TH8; the profile army must match.
presets.description: The bundled GiWiHe file explicitly references TH8. This preset selects only its deployment routine; it does not import troop or spell counts. King and Queen are selected from the intersection of current TH8 unlocks and the CSV's Hero DROP actions.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH7-12] GiWiHe v6.4.csv explicitly references TH8 and deploys King and Queen; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 9
presets.summary: TH9 GoWiPe deployment; the active profile army must match.
presets.description: The file's header identifies this as a TH9 GoWiPe attack. The preset selects only that deployment routine; it does not build a GoWiPe army. King and Queen are selected because both are unlocked and have CSV DROP actions.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH9] Shuttered GoWiPe.csv identifies itself as TH9 and deploys King and Queen; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 10
presets.summary: TH10 BoWiHe deployment; the active profile army must match.
presets.description: The bundled BoWiHe file explicitly references TH10. The preset selects only its deployment routine; it does not import a BoWiHe composition. King and Queen are selected from current TH10 unlocks that also have CSV DROP actions.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH10-12] BoWiHe v3.2.csv explicitly references TH10 and deploys King and Queen; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 11
presets.summary: TH11 ElectroLoonBat deployment; the profile army must match.
presets.description: The bundled ElectroLoonBat file explicitly covers TH11. This preset selects only its deployment routine; it does not import troop, spell or siege counts. King, Queen and Warden are the currently unlocked Heroes with matching CSV DROP actions.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH11-15]_ElectroLoonBat.csv declares TH11 and deploys King, Queen and Warden; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 12
presets.summary: TH12 ElectroLoonBat deployment; the profile army must match.
presets.description: The bundled file explicitly covers TH12. This preset selects only its deployment routine; it does not import troop, spell or siege counts. King, Queen and Warden have matching CSV DROP actions, while profile spell and siege training stay enabled.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH11-15]_ElectroLoonBat.csv declares TH12 and deploys King, Queen and Warden; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 13
presets.summary: TH13 ElectroLoonBat deployment; the profile army must match.
presets.description: The bundled file explicitly covers TH13. This preset selects only its deployment routine; it does not import troop, spell or siege counts. King, Queen, Warden and Champion are unlocked and each has a matching CSV DROP action.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH11-15]_ElectroLoonBat.csv declares TH13 and deploys King, Queen, Warden and Champion; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 14
presets.summary: TH14 ElectroLoonBat deployment; the profile army must match.
presets.description: The bundled file explicitly covers TH14. This preset selects only its deployment routine; it does not import troop, spell or siege counts. King, Queen, Warden and Champion are unlocked and each has a matching CSV DROP action.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH11-15]_ElectroLoonBat.csv declares TH14 and deploys King, Queen, Warden and Champion; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 15
presets.summary: TH15 ElectroLoonBat deployment; the profile army must match.
presets.description: TH15 is the highest Town Hall the bundled file claims. The preset selects deployment only and does not import troop, spell or siege counts. King, Queen, Warden and Champion are the source-proven DROP choices; Minion Prince and Dragon Duke are omitted.
presets.source_note: CSV/Attack/[TH11-15]_ElectroLoonBat.csv declares TH15 and deploys King, Queen, Warden and Champion; the planner applies deployment only and retains the profile army.

presets.label: Town Hall 16
presets.summary: Compatibility fallback using Standard deployment and the profile army.
presets.description: No shipped CSV declares TH16 support. This avoids pretending an older script is compatible, keeps the active profile army and visible Hero selection, and uses the wired Standard deployment for a short observed run.
presets.source_note: No shipped CSV declares TH16 support; legacy.standard is wired but current-client evidence is still required.

presets.label: Town Hall 17
presets.summary: Compatibility fallback using Standard deployment and the profile army.
presets.description: No shipped CSV declares TH17 support. This preserves the profile's known army and visible Hero selection, uses only the wired Standard deployment, and leaves diagnostic authorization entirely under operator control.
presets.source_note: No shipped CSV declares TH17 support; legacy.standard is wired but current-client evidence is still required.

presets.label: Town Hall 18
presets.summary: Compatibility fallback with no unproven TH18 script claim.
presets.description: Town Hall 18 is catalogued but its runtime fixtures are still missing and no bundled CSV declares support. The preset uses Standard deployment, preserves the visible Hero selection and stays bounded; Start validation still applies.
presets.source_note: current-client.json sets TH18 as maximum; no shipped CSV declares TH18 support and runtime fixtures remain required.
